prompts.modules: Use case: stylized-concept. Purpose-built ORIGINAL modular 2D ruin kit for a top-down game with slightly elevated front view. EXACTLY 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, eight isolated sprites with wide TRANSPARENT gutters; every sprite's full outline must fit inside its own cell. Top row left-to-right: straight wall A, straight wall B, 90-degree L wall corner, intact wall end-cap. Bottom row left-to-right: broken wall end, low collapsed-wall transition, doorway-side connecting wall collar, low foundation fragment. Straight walls are short horizontal modules, not long complete fences: flat vertical LEFT and RIGHT connection faces of identical height/depth and identical stone color, same ground/base line, no rubble or foliage at the joining faces. A and B vary large block shapes internally but have matching endpoints. Corner must connect the same wall width on its two arms, viewed consistently. End-cap and broken end terminate those same wall cross-sections. Collapse transitions naturally from standing wall to rubble. Door collar joins the side of the referenced doorway and the same wall section. Restrained moss on interior faces only. Thick controlled dark outline on structures. No photographs, surface grain, thin cracks everywhere, gray backdrop, drop-shadow haze, floor rectangles, grid, text, people, trees, separate props or extra filler. Genuine transparent alpha; clean complete silhouettes. Preserve broad readable shapes at small game size.
